name: four-hour-throttle-intermediate-reversion
rationale: 2026-10-01 lead 3: the two strongest diagnostic-capital results were four-hour block + four-hour spacing (14400/14400; 500,000 JPY Sharpe -15.02 -> +8.05, static-mix deficit narrowed to -1.37) and the 7200/7200 throttle combined with rsi 60 / bollinger 90 (the first variant ahead of its static mix at 50,000 JPY, +2.95 Sharpe over static). Neither combination has been tried at four hours. This tests whether the slower reversion horizons add value on top of the four-hour throttle, scored on total_fees_jpy and sharpe_minus_static_mix rather than trade count. Expected to fail the 50% trade-count criterion at 50,000 JPY (4h/4h made 5 trades there); recorded as a cost hypothesis under the three-consecutive-negative-runs rule.
